title: Inter Engine
tagline: Inter Engine is a cutting-edge messaging gateway engine that operates in a decentralised manner across multiple blockchain networks.
description:
Inter Engine is a cutting-edge messaging gateway engine that operates in a decentralised manner across multiple blockchain networks. It enables seamless and secure communication between different blockchain networks, allowing users to easily transfer assets and arbitrary data across these networks with ease.

The Inter Engine is built on a secure and scalable infrastructure that leverages advanced cryptographic techniques like ZK to ensure the privacy and security of all communications. It utilises a decentralised architecture that eliminates the need for intermediaries, thereby reducing the risk of censorship, hacking, and other types of cyber attacks.

The protocol was already deployed to Goerli, BNB Testnet, and Scroll Testnet.
